statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are clinically consistent with the patient's known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is ordered
The procedure code is CPT code 93226
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I34.0
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
